full_judgment: Title Suit No.93 of 1997 for permanent injunction against the defendants wherein he got an order of temporary injunction, but ultimately the suit was dismissed for default; that the plaintiff then filed Miscellaneous Case No.4 1 of 1999 under Order 9 Rule 9 for restoration of the suit and the same is also still pending; that the defendants forcibly entered into the suit property on 7-11-1999 and forcibly ousted the plaintiff therefrom with the help of their employees and made over possession to the defendant No. 8 who started making construction by dismantling the structure thereon and hence the suit was filed. During the progress of the suit, the plaintiff-respondents filed an application for injunction restraining the leave-petitioner and others from making any construction work and also from changing the nature and character of the suit property. The petitioner filed a written objection against the application for injunction on 13-8-2000. The trial court only rejected the application for injunction but also rejected the plaint taking this issue suo-moto by his judgment and order dated 13-8-2000.
